column1: # Hand decisions for the unsafe-verification ledger. Applied by
# reference remap; never edit the sidecar by hand.
#   file      census path (a comma-separated list for one row covering several)
#   owner     the enclosing fn's name, or the impl header text; * = any owner
#   expect    the artifact the regions carry at decision time (GAP for a fill,
#             or the value a corrupted re-bank left behind for a repair)
#   count     how many regions the row owns, changed + already-carrying; the
#             tool refuses the row when the tree does not match it exactly
#   reason    the contract's definition, then the code the regions are   [optional 7th column `lines`: comma list of region
# A row with expect GAP only ADDS an annotation to unannotated regions; it
# changes no existing claim. Repairs of by-id rows (expect not GAP) say so in
# the reason and are reviewed as their own commit.
# This batch (2026-11-23, ledger-recover b2): the 47 contested sites the
# reference consensus left GAP — the reference versions disagree because the
# 2026-11-21..23 per-lane re-banks attached another family's contract to

# Two contested sites stay GAP and are NOT decided here (both historical
# tags contradict the code; listed in the lane report):
#     region is the error-path close_file_fd call — neither family)
